We map it to the required SEC 8-K item, pull the company's recent filings from EDGAR, and quote the sentence that states it. FILED only when one sentence carries the claim's names and roles; otherwise FILED_RELATED, NO_FILING_YET (4-business-day filing window), NOT_A_FILING_EVENT or NOT_FOUND. Deterministic. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/event-check, $0.005 via x402.)

Strict: every number must appear next to the claim's own names (no borrowing another plan's price). Deterministic, no AI calls. By OMENZ. tools.name: market_find
tools.description: Which paid API should my agent use? Agent Market finds the paid tool for a capability across ~38,000 x402 endpoints (Bazaar index, refreshed daily). Ranked by match, then real 30-day usage (calls, unique payers); filter by max_price_usd and network; exclude= a vendor to get substitutes (tool down or rate-limited); the top picks are probed live (never paid) for status, price and drift. Capability Finder, Procurement Desk, Quote Comparator, Tool Substitute Finder and Rate-Limit Router in one call. With max_price_usd, relevant options above your limit stay visible in over_your_limit (for the owner's decision, never auto-chosen): discovery is not authorization. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/market/find, $0.002 via x402.)

tools.name: checkpoint_create
tools.description: OMENZ Checkpoint (create): split an agent job into paid milestones. Each milestone has an amount, its own deterministic acceptance tests (required_fields, field_types, regex, min_items, max_bytes, equals, url_alive, claim_evidence) and an optional deadline. Returns a signed plan and checkpoint_id. OMENZ never holds funds. By OMENZ. tools.name: checkpoint_submit

A decided milestone can't be passed or counted twice. Seller track record updated. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/checkpoint/submit, $0.01 via x402.)

One call runs Email Check + Phone Check + Domain Check (cheaper than all three) plus cross-checks: does the email domain match the company website, brand-new website, fictional/premium/VoIP phone, disposable email. FAKE_OR_UNUSABLE / WEAK / GOOD_LEAD with reasons. Send any of email, phone (+country), website. Public DNS/RDAP + offline phone data, no SMTP probe, nothing stored. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/lead/check, $0.005 via x402.)

tools.name: link_check
tools.description: OMENZ Link Check: where does this link really go, and is it safe to follow, sign in or pay? Follows the redirect chain hop by hop (unshortens bit.ly/tinyurl etc.), then checks the destination: TLS certificate (valid, issuer, days to expiry, hostname match), destination domain age (RDAP), plain http, page status. DANGER (bad/expired cert, new domain < 30 days, redirect loop, private-network target) / CAUTION (shortener, lands on a different site than shown, http, expiring cert, many hops, 4xx/5xx) / UNREACHABLE / OK. Never submits forms, runs scripts or pays. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/link/check, $0.003 via x402.)

tools.name: email_check
tools.description: OMENZ Email Check: is this email address real enough to use? UNDELIVERABLE (bad syntax, no such domain, no mail server) / RISKY (disposable throwaway provider, or a domain with no SPF and no DMARC) / DELIVERABLE_LIKELY. Also: free webmail vs company domain, role account (info@, sales@), plus-addressing and the normalized address. Public DNS only, no SMTP probing, nothing stored. Pairs with Phone Check for leads and signups. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/email/check, $0.002 via x402.)

tools.name: phone_check
tools.description: OMENZ Phone Check: is this a real, dialable phone number and what kind? VALID / POSSIBLE_BUT_INVALID / INVALID / FICTIONAL (555-01XX), E.164 + international + national formats, country, type (mobile, landline, toll-free, premium-rate, VoIP...), location, original carrier, time zones, can-it-SMS, and warnings before an agent calls or texts (premium-rate cost, VoIP, landline). Fully offline (Google libphonenumber data): nothing leaves OMENZ, nothing stored. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/phone/check, $0.002 via x402.)

tools.name: domain_check
tools.description: OMENZ Domain Check: should your agent trust this domain before paying it or emailing it? Registration age and expiry (RDAP), registrar and registry status, does it resolve, can it receive mail (MX), SPF and DMARC (can others spoof it?). RED_FLAGS if unregistered, not resolving, on hold or registered < 30 days ago; CAUTION if young, expiring, or missing mail/anti-spoofing records; LOOKS_ESTABLISHED otherwise. Subdomains are checked against their registered domain. Public data (RDAP + DNS-over-HTTPS), no keys. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/domain/check, $0.003 via x402.)

tools.name: package_check
tools.description: OMENZ Package Check: is this software package safe for your agent to install? npm, PyPI, Go, Cargo, Maven, NuGet. BLOCK if the package does not exist (hallucinated name: slopsquatting risk, with 'did you mean') or the version has HIGH/CRITICAL known vulnerabilities; CAUTION if deprecated, under 30 days old, any known vuln, no license, or a near-miss of a popular package name (typosquat); SAFE_TO_INSTALL otherwise. Returns the vulns, the version to upgrade to, license and package age. Sources: deps.dev + OSV.dev. Deterministic, read-only. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/package/check, $0.003 via x402.)

tools.name: token_check
tools.description: OMENZ Token Check (Base): is this token safe to hold or accept, before your agent buys, swaps or takes it as payment? Reads the contract itself: real ERC-20 or not, upgradeable proxy (EIP-1967 / OpenZeppelin slots: code can change under you), active owner and the powers in its bytecode (mint, pause, blacklist/freeze, fees, tx limits), owner/admin on the OFAC SDN list. SAFE_TO_HOLD / CAUTION / RED_FLAGS with every reason; regulated stablecoins labeled (issuer freeze is by design). Deterministic: no AI grades, no price predictions. Public chain data, never signs. Source-code verification via Sourcify (token + implementation; unverified = CAUTION). By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/token/check, $0.005 via x402.)

tools.name: allowance
tools.description: Allowance Check (Base): how much can this spender move from this wallet right now? Reads the live ERC-20 allowance and the owner's balance: UNLIMITED (risk HIGH) / COVERS_FULL_BALANCE / LIMITED / NO_ALLOWANCE, with a safe next action and the exact revoke call (approve(spender, 0)). Optional intended_usd says whether a stablecoin allowance covers your next payment. For agents before approving, paying through a contract, or cleaning up old approvals. Public chain data, never signs. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/allowance, $0.002 via x402.)

tools.name: seller_acceptance_check
tools.description: Seller Payment-Acceptance Check: is your x402 server turning away paying agents? We probe YOUR route with a throwaway, unfunded key (no money can move): a fresh payment must reach your facilitator; a payment echoing an older 402 (changed description/example, changed timeout) must not be refused; an x402 v1 X-PAYMENT must not be ignored silently. Verdict ACCEPTS_GOOD_MONEY / REFUSES_GOOD_MONEY / SERVES_UNPAID / NO_VALID_402 with each problem and the exact fix. OMENZ found this leak on its own server: a funded repeat buyer was refused 4 times. Max 5 requests to your URL. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/seller/acceptance-check, $0.05 via x402.)

tools.name: settlement_cost
tools.description: Settlement Cost Check (Base): what moving money costs RIGHT NOW (live gas price, L1 data fee, ETH/USD from Chainlink on Base) for an x402 settlement (~86,550 gas, measured), a USDC transfer, an ETH transfer and an approval, in ETH and USD. Send amount_usd (+ payments_per_day) to learn whether a payment that small is worth settling on its own: SETTLE / BATCH_OR_CREDITS / DONT_SETTLE_SINGLY, the overhead %, break-even payment size, and cheaper options (CDP free tier, Circle Gateway batching, prepaid credits). By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/settlement-cost, $0.002 via x402.)

tools.name: guard
tools.description: OMENZ Transaction Guard: ONE call before money moves. 'PAY $X TO Y FOR Z' -> GO / CAUTION / STOP with every check: budget authorized (Shared Budget), counterparty checked (Authorize: live 402, payTo, known seller, OFAC sanctions screen, fair price + Seller Track Record), DUPLICATE PAYMENT checked (OMENZ records and your on-chain USDC history to that payee, Base), quoted price unchanged, settlement economics, expected delivery recorded (seller's advertised output fingerprint). Then checkout/close: settled -> delivery verified -> signed receipt -> reconciled. Send url (or q), payer (your wallet), quoted_price_usd, purpose, budget_id. Larger purchases: guard/credit at 10 bps of the protected value (min $0.01, max $5). Never touches your money. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/guard, $0.05 via x402.)

tools.name: budget_delegate
tools.description: Delegation Budget (agent allowances): a parent budget's OWNER gives a child agent its own bounded allowance: human/company -> supervisor agent -> workers -> sub-agents (4 levels). The child can only NARROW the parent: cap <= parent, per-purchase max, allowed payees (subset), blocked payees (inherited), velocity limit (purchases/hour), expiry <= parent. Every child spend is checked against and counted in every ancestor, so the company cap holds across the whole tree; freezing a parent stops all descendants; budget/status shows spend by child. Header X-Budget-Key = the parent's owner_key. Bookkeeping only. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/budget/delegate, $0.01 via x402.)

tools.name: settlement_rescue
tools.description: Settlement Rescue: 'payment weird? give it to us.' Timeout, 5xx or no PAYMENT-RESPONSE after paying, and you must decide whether to pay again. Send the X-PAYMENT header you sent (or the tx hash, or payer + payee + amount). We read the EIP-3009 authorization's on-chain state on Base: SETTLED (nonce used: here is the tx, do NOT pay again) / NOT_SETTLED (expired unused: safe to pay again ONCE) / STILL_UNCERTAIN (unused but still valid: a facilitator can still settle it, do NOT sign a new one yet, with seconds left) / NOT_FOUND_ON_CHAIN, plus a duplicate-payment scan, a safe next action and a signed record for refunds and disputes. Read-only. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/settlement/rescue, $0.05 via x402.)

tools.name: market_job
tools.description: OMENZ Market job desk: tell OMENZ the JOB ('token price', 'weather by city', 'company enrichment by domain'). We search ~38,000 x402 endpoints, live-probe the matches (unpaid), and rank WORKING providers by live price and latency, each with its OMENZ-verified history (purchases checked, delivery rate, verified sales), plus settlement economics and a ready-to-send Transaction Guard request for the pick. Then guard -> pay -> checkout/close -> (settlement/rescue if weird). Want it guarded in the same call? POST market/job/guarded ($0.05). Never pays a provider. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/market/job, $0.01 via x402.)

tools.name: dispute_packet
tools.description: Dispute Packet: a purchase went bad (not delivered, wrong output, partial, overcharged, duplicate). One call builds the machine-readable case: settlement proof on Base (Settlement Rescue: did money move, how much, to whom, duplicates), the seller's own advertised output captured live (what was promised), a Delivery Check of what came back, a timeline, and a signed refund request (remedy + amount + evidence strength), all hash-listed in an Ed25519-signed manifest anyone can verify offline. Send checkout_id or url + tx_hash / payment_header / payer+pay_to, the delivered response and the issue. OMENZ packages evidence; it never rules on disputes or moves money. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/dispute/packet, $0.10 via x402.)
